column1: # Known failures of the fn-value family in tests/shapesweep.rs, one `id<TAB>kinds` row each.
# The list only shrinks. A new failure fails the gate; a row that no longer fails
# is reported, and VYRN_PIN=write deletes it. Grow it by hand, with a reason here.
# Each row fails to build after vyrn check accepts it: "no lowering for the body
# of .. the core did not state". filter and timeout: a lambda that captures
# the value and passes it to a function, handed to a std function.
